name: QuayHelm
tagline: The operating system for the modern marina.
positioning: QuayHelm unifies slip assignments, dockage contracts, and billing into one command center built for owner-operated marinas.

hero.h1: Run every slip, contract, and invoice from one helm.
hero.sub: QuayHelm gives owner-operated marinas a single system of record for dockage agreements, seasonal billing, and waitlist management — no more spreadsheets on the fuel dock.

features.title: Slip Assignment Grid
features.description: Drag-and-drop vessels onto a live berth map that flags length, beam, and draft conflicts before a boat ever leaves the fairway.

features.title: Dockage Contracts
features.description: Generate seasonal, transient, and liveaboard agreements from templates, collect e-signatures, and auto-renew with prorated rates.

features.title: Recurring Billing
features.description: Invoice dockage, metered electric, and fuel in one statement, with card-on-file autopay and automatic late-fee escalation.

features.title: Waitlist Engine
features.description: Rank prospects by vessel size and tenure, then offer openings in order with a 48-hour claim window and full audit trail.

features.title: Work Orders
features.description: Log haul-outs, winterizations, and dock repairs, assign dockhands, and bill labor and parts straight to the slip holder.

features.title: Occupancy Reporting
features.description: See utilization, revenue per foot, and seasonal turnover across every dock so you can price the next season with confidence.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated four spreadsheets and a paper ledger into QuayHelm in one off-season. Renewals that took three weeks now close in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Margaret Ellison

testimonials.quote: The slip grid caught a beam conflict that would have wedged a 44-footer into a 12-foot berth. That single save paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Daniel Voss

testimonials.quote: Autopay on metered electric changed our cash flow entirely. Delinquent accounts dropped from 18 percent to under three.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
